subject: TAKING render_pipeline.inc plan/variant memo (ways, hash, miss-reason counters) + one TEGU_PERF_ENCODE print line in render_encoder.inc
body: For the device plan-miss rate (c6l ui60: 59% misses). render_pipeline.inc: plan memo 4->16 ways with a key hash pre-check, variant memo 2->8 ways, miss classification counters (draw-count only / texture size only / buffer offset only / other / cold). render_encoder.inc: only the tegu_enc_report() snprintf line gets the extra counters; the other uncommitted hunks in render_encoder.inc (not mine) are untouched. Exact: same key semantics, host TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY re-runs the planner on every hit.
